summary: Full backend + frontend testing of NEXUS multi-provider AI hub. All 19 pytest backend tests PASS. SSE streaming verified with proper status -> content -> done events. Frontend Playwright tests verified: app loads, NEXUS logo, all 6 AI modes clickable, settings drawer with key add/delete (auto-detection by prefix works: openai/gemini/anthropic/groq/emergent), chat streaming in General mode, code mode with syntax highlighting + language badge + copy button, session pin/rename/delete, search filtering, status bar updates (EMERGENT · Emergent Universal Key · N tokens used).

issues: Status bar initially shows 'NO PROVIDER · 0 tokens used' before any chat; expected to show active key (Emergent Universal Key) immediately on load. Switches to 'EMERGENT · Emergent Universal Key' only after the first chat completes.

action_items: (Optional) Initialize APIStatusBar with the active key from /api/keys on app load so it doesn't show 'NO PROVIDER' before the first chat.
critical_code_review_comments: Provider detection ordering is correct: sk-ant- checked before sk- (anthropic before openai). Verified by test_add_anthropic_key returning provider=anthropic.
FastAPI trailing-slash routing works (redirect_slashes=False); /api/keys and /api/sessions return 200 without slash.

Chat content streams in chunks client-side (emergentintegrations send_message + chunking) - works but each chunk emits whole text deltas via 'content' event (verified 2 content events for short reply).
Encryption (Fernet) and masked_key handling functioning - /api/keys returns '...XXXX' format only.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed keys/sessions and clean up after themselves. Active Emergent Universal Key already seeded in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 backend pytest tests pass in ~3.5s. SSE chat-stream returns events: {'status': 1, 'content': 2+, 'done': 1, '[DONE]': 1}. UI selectors confirmed: data-testid='mode-{id}', 'session-item-{id}', 'pin-session-{id}', 'edit-session-{id}', 'delete-session-{id}', 'delete-key-{id}', 'settings-drawer', 'add-key-button', 'key-label-input', 'key-value-input', 'save-key-button', 'chat-input', 'send-message-button', 'message-user/assistant', 'copy-code-button', 'api-status-bar'. Mode click creates new session automatically.
